signal: Onspring launched Onspring AI in October 2025, embedding intelligent automation across its GRC platform used by enterprises like Warner Bros. Discovery

email.subject1: a signal play for Onspring's partners
email.body1:
Samantha, saw Onspring launch Onspring AI across the GRC platform this fall.

A launch like that usually opens far more co-sell motion across the partner ecosystem than the team can cover by hand, and partner-sourced pipeline leaks in that gap. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across partner targets, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Onspring's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: 3 drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Samantha, quick follow-up for Onspring.

Partner-sourced pipeline usually depends on consistent, personalized outreach to each partner's accounts, which is exactly what stalls when the team is stretched. Tighter 75-100 word emails alone tend to lift reply rates 67%, and most co-sell motions never get that consistency.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top partner targets. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Samantha, last bit of proof for Onspring.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Onspring's partner-sourced reply rate likely compares to other GRC and SaaS ecosystems. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Samantha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and rolling out new AI capabilities is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your partner motion? I will tailor it to Onspring either way.
